# PDF pp.190-193), the assembler's own list of every symbol defined and never
# referenced, with its value.  Transcribed 2026-11-06 from 300/600 dpi renders.
# The fourteen respelled rows were examined at 600 dpi.
# Columns: printed page, row on the page, the glyphs as printed (octal C read
# as 0), the symbol as the decks spell it, the "* 1" mark, the printed value,
# the note.  The "* 1" mark falls on exactly the symbols defined inside the
# TAIL,(2)G block (opened printed p.2 line 10, closed p.98 line 37); what the
# assembler means by it is not established.
# A printed name differs from the deck's only where the drum's known wear
# explains it (B->E, T->I, P->F, open O, 0/O, 1/I); the note says which.
